description: How ReConnect databases/core/data_all.json#screening_tools maps onto screening_tools.json (the Scales & Screeners registry, crossover brainstorm v2 item #12). Read by sync_from_reconnect.py --dataset screening_tools and by the registry's build-time validator once one exists. Every upstream key must appear in exactly one of fieldMap or denylist; an unclassified key is reported and fails the run (exit 1). The registry carries administration facts, score bands, psychometrics and the custodian link — never item text, anchors or a fillable form (CLAUDE.md: the library teaches administration; it does not reproduce instruments).
status: DRAFT — awaiting faculty gate G0-S (field triage) and roster ratification. Drafted 2026-09-30 from a direct read of the 67 upstream records (30 keys).

name.note: slug of the upstream name is the registry id; verified against the custodian page

tool_name.note: duplicate of name upstream; carried as the display abbreviation

description.note: the instrument's expanded name, e.g. 'Patient Health Questionnaire-9'

items.note: an item COUNT (e.g. '9'), never item text; the library teaches administration and does not reproduce instruments

cost.note: 'Free / Public Domain' vs licensed; cross-check instrument_rights.json before any link-only decision

website.note: the official form/custodian page the registry links to instead of hosting the instrument

clinical_cutoffs.note: score bands as facts; verify against the cited source, never re-derive

sensitivity.note: carry the figure AND its cutoff/population qualifier; verify against the cited paper

source.note: author/publisher attribution as ReConnect records it (e.g. 'APA/Pfizer')

evidence_level.note: ReConnect's I–IV grading; shown with its provenance, not re-graded

symptom_cluster.note: ReConnect's cluster vocabulary (Mood, Anxiety, …); map to the library's topic slugs at record-authoring time

target_audience.note: ['clinician'] etc.; feeds the MS3/resident tier toggle

safety_tier.note: ReConnect tiering; a suicide-risk instrument is safetyLevel high regardless

when_to_use.note: clinical-use prose; re-authored under faculty review, quoted only from attested pages

frequency.note: re-administration cadence is practice guidance, not a label fact

freshness_status.note: drives the STALE section of the report

rss_layers.note: ReConnect RSSM layer tags; not clerkship vocabulary

denylist.patient_profile: ReConnect persona labels ('Anxious Achiever Burnout', …) are RSSM product vocabulary, not clinical facts; never shown to learners
denylist.item_stems: instrument reproduction rule (CLAUDE.md): the library teaches administration and never ships item text — pre-denylisted so an upstream addition can never be carried
denylist.anchor_text: instrument reproduction rule: anchor ladders are never carried (COWS anchors retired 2026-09-10, decision cows-anchors-retired)
denylist.scoring_form: instrument reproduction rule: a fillable/scored copy of a copyrighted form is reproduction even when no text is copied (Stanley-Brown terms)
